page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c4g1.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ecs.gn5i family, running on the KVM hypervisor. The instance features 4 dedicated physical CPU cores with 1 thread per core, providing 4 vCPUs. It is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, which translates to 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server includes a bundled graphics processing unit, specifically one NVIDIA P4 GPU with 8 GB of VRAM. There is no local storage provided on this instance, meaning all storage requirements must be met through attached network storage. The baseline network bandwidth is rated at 2 Gbps, and the instance does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.gn5i-c4g1.xlarge offers entry-level GPU acceleration paired with a balanced vCPU-to-RAM ratio. The primary tradeoff is the lack of local storage and a relatively low baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps, which may limit data-intensive transfer operations. This hardware profile is designed for workloads such as low-concurrency GPU-accelerated inference, basic video transcoding, and lightweight machine learning model deployment.
